claims: The 2026 Masters Tournament has a total purse of $22.5 million.
The winner of the 2026 Masters Tournament receives $4,500,000.
The 2025 Masters Tournament had a $21 million purse.
The runner-up in the 2026 Masters Tournament earns $2,430,000.
The third-place finisher in the 2026 Masters Tournament receives $1,530,000.
Top-12 finishers in the 2026 Masters Tournament earn at least $517,500.
4th place in the 2026 Masters Tournament receives $1,080,000.
5th place in the 2026 Masters Tournament receives $900,000.
6th place in the 2026 Masters Tournament receives $810,000.
7th place in the 2026 Masters Tournament receives $753,750.
8th place in the 2026 Masters Tournament receives $697,500.
9th place in the 2026 Masters Tournament receives $652,500.
10th place in the 2026 Masters Tournament receives $607,500.
Players who make the cut in the 2026 Masters Tournament are top 50 and ties.
Professionals missing the cut in the 2026 Masters Tournament receive $25,000 each.
Amateur players do not receive monetary prizes in the 2026 Masters Tournament.
The winner of the 2026 Masters Tournament receives a lifetime exemption to the Masters.
The winner of the 2026 Masters Tournament receives a gold medal.
